name: Helmet ear muffs (lowered)
description: Two padded hearing-protector cups on sprung steel arms that clip into the side slots of a hard hat, swung down over the ears.
notes: Two orange cups 80 mm across with black cushions, on steel arms swung down into the working position, each ending in a black slot clip; 190 mm from cushion to clip. This is the cups-down state; the cups-up standby item `attachable_ear_muffs` is its own reference item with its own model, and switching between them waits on Deadvox item states. Muffling sound needs a hearing system Deadvox does not have yet. CHECK VOLUME (x10.5): the open arms span air that the reference packs away. It mounts on a helmet, so it `fits` `helmet` and its `wearable` has no slot. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Hardened steel mail aventail

CHECK VOLUME (x6): the reference counts the mail bunched up, and a heap would not read as a curtain. The xl and xs sizes share the model.
